description: Mediums, what a What can be passed over, and Mediations: the stack of Mediums a Connection is passed over, from the top down, each optionally realized by a Transformation down into the Medium's Language and one up out of it. A Mediation states only that its What passes over the Medium; how is the realization's, and usually the implementation's, business. Optional. Extends Deployment.

axioms.about: A Medium's call is an Interaction of the Component that defines it
axioms.formula: all m in Medium. m.call.component == m.component

axioms.about: A Medium's call is over the Medium's Language
axioms.formula: all m in Medium. m.call.language == m.language

axioms.about: A nested Component imports a Medium only from its siblings, or from what a Component it is nested in imports
axioms.formula: all c in Component, p in c.parent, m in c.importedMediums. m.component != c and (m.component in p.components or m in c.^parent.importedMediums or m.component in c.^parent.importedComponents)

axioms.about: A Mediation is over a Medium the deployed Component has access to
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, k in m.connection.deployment.component. m.how.component in k.*parent or m.how in k.importedMediums or m.how.component in k.importedComponents

axioms.about: A realization goes down into the Medium's Language
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, d in m.down, o in d.output. o.language == m.how.language

axioms.about: A realization comes up from the Medium's Language
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, u in m.up, p in u.parameters. p.type.language == m.how.language

axioms.about: The top Mediation's realization goes down from its Connection's What
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, d in m.down, p in d.parameters, i in m.connection.what. no m.above => p.type.language == i.language

axioms.about: The top Mediation's realization comes up to its Connection's What
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, u in m.up, o in u.output, i in m.connection.what. no m.above => o.language == i.language

axioms.about: A lower Mediation's realization goes down from the Medium above it
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, a in m.above, d in m.down, p in d.parameters. p.type.language == a.how.language

axioms.about: A lower Mediation's realization comes up to the Medium above it
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, a in m.above, u in m.up, o in u.output. o.language == a.how.language

axioms.about: A realization is accessible to the Component a Connection goes from
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, t in m.down, k in m.connection.from.of. t.component in k.*parent or t in k.importedTransformations or t.component in k.importedComponents

axioms.about: A realization's way up is accessible to the Component a Connection goes from
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, t in m.up, k in m.connection.from.of. t.component in k.*parent or t in k.importedTransformations or t.component in k.importedComponents

axioms.about: A realization is accessible to the Instance a Connection goes to
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, t in m.down, k in m.connection.to.of. t.component in k.*parent or t in k.importedTransformations or t.component in k.importedComponents

axioms.about: A realization's way up is accessible to the Instance a Connection goes to
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, t in m.up, k in m.connection.to.of. t.component in k.*parent or t in k.importedTransformations or t.component in k.importedComponents

axioms.about: A realization is accessible to the Component a Connection goes to
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, t in m.down, k in m.connection.toComponent. t.component in k.*parent or t in k.importedTransformations or t.component in k.importedComponents

axioms.about: A realization's way up is accessible to the Component a Connection goes to
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, t in m.up, k in m.connection.toComponent. t.component in k.*parent or t in k.importedTransformations or t.component in k.importedComponents

axioms.about: A Mediation's below is a Mediation of the same Connection
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, b in m.below. b.connection == m.connection

axioms.about: A Connection's Mediations have one top
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, a in c.mediations, b in c.mediations. (no a.above and no b.above) => a == b

axioms.about: The Mediation stack has no cycles
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation. not m in m.^below
